==1st Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|
|width="24%"|The northernmost flat wall can be bombed to reveal a door, but the man inside will charge you 20 Rupees for repairs.
|width="24%"|
|width="24%"|Bombing the north wall not far from the stairs will reveal a door, but the man inside will charge you 20 Rupees for repairs.
|-
! 2
|Bombing the wall to the right of the stairs will open a door to a Money Making Game.
|
|If you bomb the wall to the left of the leftmost tree, you can discover a shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 Rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 Rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 Rupees.
|By bombing the right side of the northernmost wall, you can find a cave where you will receive 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 3
|
|One of the center tombstones is actually a hidden entrance to the most powerful sword, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Sword}}.  However, you can only wield this sword if you have at least 12 Heart Containers in your life meter.
|In this area, you will find the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 6|sixth dungeon]].
|This is one of the secret passage exits.  You must have the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}} in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage.  The passage links to the other exits in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]] and [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|Section 4]].
|-
! 4
|
|
|
|Bomb the wall between the two staircases to reveal the entrance to a cave where a medicine woman lives.  If you have shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, she will sell you a {{im/loz|Item|Red Potion}} for 68 Rupees, or a {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 Rupees.
|-
! 5
|

==2nd Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|Spectacle Rock may be an entrance to death, but it is in this obscure corner of Hyrule that you will actually find the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 9|ninth dungeon]] by bombing the middle of the north wall.
|width="24%"|The northernmost flat wall can be bombed to reveal a door, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|width="24%"|If you bomb the north wall to the right of the stairs, you can reveal a cave where a medicine woman lives.  If you have shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, she will sell you a {{im/loz|Item|Red Potion}} for 68 rupees, or a {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|width="24%"|Bombing the north wall not far from the stairs will reveal a door, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|-
! 2
|Bombing the wall to the right of the stairs will open a door to a Money Making Game.
|It is in this location where you can find the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}} needed to show the medicine woman if you wish to buy the {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}}, by pushing the left most boulder down to reveal a stairwell.
|If you bomb the wall to the left of the leftmost tree, you can discover a shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
|By bombing the right side of the northernmost wall, you can find a cave where you will receive 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 3
|One of the center tombstones is actually a hidden entrance to a man with an offer you can't refuse: an extra {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
|
|In this area, you won't find a dungeon entrance, but rather a {{im/loz|Enemy|Red Moblin}} who will give you 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|This is one of the secret passage exits.  You must have the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}} in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage.  The passage links to the other exits in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]] and [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|Section 4]].
|-
! 4
|Playing a few notes on the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} are necessary to reveal the fact that one of the tombstones is in fact the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 6|sixth dungeon]].
|
|
|Bomb the wall between the two staircases to reveal the entrance to a cave where a medicine woman lives. If you have shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}} she will sell you a {{im/loz|Item|Red Potion}} for 68 rupees, or a {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|-
! 5
|
|

|}
